title: TM-QUALITY (SYSTEMS 1)
description: Need a person who is hands on in Quality control, Quality Assurance, Customer Complaint Management and IMS Audit Procedures - Both Internal and External. Interface with Customers for improvement with product Quality. Promoting QMS, EMS, OHSMS among team members.

title: TM-MFG (QLTY-FL4-TEAM B)
description:
Monitoring of Product Quality during Production, Storage, Re-processing, packing and dispatch
  
  
Control of Quality to ensure meeting with Customer/Standard requirement
  
  
Maintaining analytical equipment in healthy conditions for reliable results
  
  
Handling of Non Conformance
  
  
Analysis of Customer Claims, feed-back/coordination with other functions for corrective actions,
  
  
Benchmarking Quality level of product with competitor and other Saint-Gobain Plants
  
  
Configuration of Quality Codes for different products
  
  
Calibration of all analytical instruments
  
  
Maintain and to improve QMS, EMS & OHSAS performance pertain to department
  
  
Defining Specifications for packing materials
  
  
Assessment of Suppliers of critical packing materials
  
  
Ageing analysis of Glass and Warehouse audit
  
  
Interpretation of analytical results
  
  
Interface with Customers for improvement with product Quality
  
  
Monitoring and upgrading skill level of Quality personnel
